dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, can you teach me a recipe for tom yum?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, kən juː ˈtiːtʃ miː ə ˈrɛsəpi fər ˌtɑːm ˈjʌm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sure! It's easy. First, boil some water.
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr! ɪts ˈiːzi. ˈfɜːrst, ˈbɔɪl sʌm ˈwɔːtər.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK. What do I do next?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ˈwʌt duː aɪ ˈduː ˈnɛkst?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Next, add the herbs. Then chop the mushrooms and add them, too.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɛkst, ˈæd ði ˈɜːrbz. ˈðɛn ˈtʃɑːp ðə ˈmʌʃruːmz ənd ˈæd ðɛm, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Should I add the chilies now?
dialogue.reading: ʃʊd aɪ ˈæd ðə ˈtʃɪliz ˈnaʊ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. After that, add some fish sauce and stir it.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ˈæftər ˈðæt, ˈæd sʌm ˈfɪʃ ˌsɔːs ənd ˈstɜːr ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Finally, add some lime juice. Now we can eat!
dialogue.reading: ˈfaɪnəli, ˈæd sʌm ˈlaɪm ˌdʒuːs. ˈnaʊ wiː kən ˈiːt!
